P.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lulu''' is assisted by ''Pix'', an {{tip|untargetable}} faerie, who follows her around and fires a barrage of 3 bolts towards her target whenever she uses a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}}. Each bolt deals {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 39}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it collides with, for a total of {{as|{{pplevel|5*3 to 39*3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} on hitting a single target with all three bolts.
P.description2: Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers ''Pix's'' help to them, causing him to fire the bolts dependent on their basic attacks.
P.description3: ''Pix snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she is too far away.''

Q.name: Glitterlance
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' and ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' each fire a magic bolt towards the target point, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% decaying over 2 seconds.
Q.description2: Enemies take {{ccs|50% damage|magic}} from a second bolt.

W.name: Whimsy
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Whimsy'' on herself or a champion.
W.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' launches a spell onto the target enemy champion that {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} them into a harmless critter for a duration, during which their {{as|movement speed}} is reduced by {{as|60|ms}}, and {{tip|disarm|disarms}} them for the same duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' instantly casts erratic magic upon the target allied champion or herself, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
{{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|3 to 4}} seconds}}

E.name: Help, Pix!
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' can cast ''Help, Pix!'' on herself or an ally or enemy.
E.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the far side of the target enemy for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the same duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Self / Ally Cast:}} '''Lulu''' sends ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' to the target ally for {{fd|6.25}} seconds. If the target is a {{tip|champion}}, they are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

R.name: Wild Growth
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lulu''' enlarges herself or the target allied champion, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, the target gains {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}} and 40% increased [[size]] and {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies, which lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
